paragraphs: Every Friday I sit down with doctors, team members and industry leaders to talk about what is working in dentistry right now. Marketing, reviews, AI, team training and practice growth.
Nearly 350 episodes in, the show is now in season nine. Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
